brief_rationale: All five responsibility-chain requirements are met with safe, case-specific guidance. The doctor performed comprehensive newborn triage, reconciled timeline records from workspace data, clarified medication safety including the iron supplement discrepancy, provided specific follow-up owner and timing, and obtained caregiver teach-back. Two high-order points are completed: HO2 (verification logic distinguishing record timing from current state) and HO4 (safe bounded closure acknowledging prior HIE history). Grade 5 requires no in-chain error and at least two completed high-order points with meaningful trajectory impact, both satisfied here.

The reasoning explicitly integrates timing, showing these are completed treatments from hospitalization, not current active problems.
The discharge instructions were ultimately clear - the family had both vitamin D and iron syrup, just needed clarification on dosing. No broken responsibility chain required repair.
